Engrave your chest or robe with the Wild Strikes rune:


While you are in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, party or raid members within 100 yards gain increased combat ferocity.  Each melee hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker an extra attack with 20% additional Attack Power. No effect if the target is already benefitting from Windfury Totem.

410023.name: Engrave Pants - Savage Roar
410023.description:
Engrave your pants with the Savage Roar rune:


Requires Cat Form
Finishing move that increases Physical damage done by 30% while in Cat Form.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 14 seconds
   2 points: 19 seconds
   3 points: 24 seconds
   4 points: 29 seconds
   5 points: 34 seconds

410025.name: Engrave Gloves - Mangle
410025.description:
Engrave your gloves with the Mangle rune:


Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 26 and generating a high amount of threat.

410061.name: Engrave Chest - Fury of Stormrage
410061.description:
Engrave your chest or robe with the Fury of Stormrage rune:


Reduces the mana cost of Wrath by 100% and each time you deal damage with Wrath you have a 12% chance for your next cast of Healing Touch within 15 sec to be instant and castable in any shapeshift form. Allows Wrath to be cast while in Tree of Life form.

410093.name: Engrave Belt - Fire Nova
410093.description:
Engrave your belt with the Fire Nova rune:


Your Fire Nova Totem spell is replaced with Fire Nova, which causes your current Fire totem to emit damage at its location.

410094.name: Engrave Chest - Overload
410094.description:
Engrave your chest or robe with the Overload rune:


Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

410095.name: Engrave Gloves - Lava Burst
410095.description:
Engrave your gloves with the Lava Burst rune:


You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 123 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

410097.name: Engrave Gloves - Water Shield
410097.description:
Engrave your gloves with the Water Shield rune:


The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds.  Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

410098.name: Engrave Chest - Shield Mastery
410098.description:
Engrave your chest or robe with the Shield Mastery rune:


Each time you Block, you regenerate mana equal to 8% of your maximum mana and you gain Armor equal to 30% of your shield's armor value, stacking up to 5 times. You also always gain 10% increased chance to Block and 15% increased Block value.

In addition, each time you use a Shock ability, you gain 4 Spell Damage for each point of your defense skill beyond …. Lasts 15 sec.

410101.name: Engrave Pants - Earth Shield
410101.description:
Engrave your pants with the Earth Shield rune:


Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for 157.32.  This effect can only occur once every few seconds.  9 charges. Lasts 10 min.  Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time.

Engrave your bracers with the Riptide
 rune:

410107.name: Engrave Pants - Way of Earth

descriptions: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 10%.

133500.name: Weapon Expertise
descriptions: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

136840.name: Essence of Innovation
descriptions: Craft an Essence of Innovation and research a new recipe for a non-gathering Primary tradeskill in which you have reached 300 skill.

136845.name: Meticulous
descriptions: Grants a 3% chance to gain extra results from First Aid recipes and from Alchemy Elixir, Potion, Draught, and Flask recipes.
Grants a 6% chance to gain extra results from First Aid recipes and from Alchemy Elixir, Potion, Draught, and Flask recipes.
Grants a 9% chance to gain extra results from First Aid recipes and from Alchemy Elixir, Potion, Draught, and Flask recipes.
Grants a 12% chance to gain extra results from First Aid recipes and from Alchemy Elixir, Potion, Draught, and Flask recipes.
Grants a 15% chance to gain extra results from First Aid recipes and from Alchemy Elixir, Potion, Draught, and Flask recipes.

136846.name: Master Forager
descriptions: Gain 1 increased skill in Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, and 5 increased skill in Fishing.
Gain 2 increased skill in Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, and 10 increased skill in Fishing.
Gain 3 increased skill in Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, and 15 increased skill in Fishing.
Gain 4 increased skill in Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, and 20 increased skill in Fishing.
Gain 5 increased skill in Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, and 25 increased skill in Fishing.

136847.name: Dedicated Study
descriptions: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 3 of a random Elemental Essence.

136851.name: Optimization - NYI
descriptions: Materials used by your Engineering, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, and Tailoring recipes have a 1% chance per item to be refunded on completing the recipe.
Materials used by your Engineering, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, and Tailoring recipes have a 2% chance per item to be refunded on completing the recipe.
Materials used by your Engineering, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, and Tailoring recipes have a 3% chance per item to be refunded on completing the recipe.
Materials used by your Engineering, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, and Tailoring recipes have a 4% chance per item to be refunded on completing the recipe.
Materials used by your Engineering, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, and Tailoring recipes have a 5% chance per item to be refunded on completing the recipe.

136854.name: Second Home
descriptions: Returns you to the rest area where you most recently set your Second Home. When used in a rest area, makes that location your Second Home. This ability shares a cooldown with Hearthstones.

136857.name: Master Swimmer
descriptions: Your underwater breath lasts 50% longer than normal and you swim 15% faster.
Your underwater breath lasts 100% longer than normal and you swim 30% faster.

136859.name: Diplomat
descriptions: Increases your reputation gains by 2%.
Increases your reputation gains by 4%.
Increases your reputation gains by 6%.
Increases your reputation gains by 8%.
Increases your reputation gains by 10%.

136860.name: Play Dead
descriptions: Gives you a 5% chance of being able to resurrect with 20% Health and Mana. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds. This effect cannot trigger more often than once every 5 min.
Gives you a 10% chance of being able to resurrect with 20% Health and Mana. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds. This effect cannot trigger more often than once every 5 min.
Gives you a 15% chance of being able to resurrect with 20% Health and Mana. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds. This effect cannot trigger more often than once every 5 min.
Gives you a 20% chance of being able to resurrect with 20% Health and Mana. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds. This effect cannot trigger more often than once every 5 min.
Gives you a 25% chance of being able to resurrect with 20% Health and Mana. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds. This effect cannot trigger more often than once every 5 min.

136862.name: Iron Stomach
descriptions: Reduces your cooldown for using potions by 6 sec. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.
Reduces your cooldown for using potions by 12 sec. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.
Reduces your cooldown for using potions by 18 sec. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

136863.name: Personal Banking
descriptions: All innkeepers can now also grant you access to your bank. This access has a 1 hr cooldown.

136872.name: Better Living Through Chemistry
descriptions: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from elixirs and flasks by 20%.
Increases the duration of beneficial effects from elixirs and flasks by 40%.
Increases the duration of beneficial effects from elixirs and flasks by 60%.
Increases the duration of beneficial effects from elixirs and flasks by 80%.
Increases the duration of beneficial effects from elixirs and flasks by 100%.

136873.name: Fast Recovery
descriptions: You recover an additional 0.5% of your Health and Mana every 5 sec while not in combat.
You recover an additional 1.0% of your Health and Mana every 5 sec while not in combat.
You recover an additional 1.5% of your Health and Mana every 5 sec while not in combat.
You recover an additional 2.0% of your Health and Mana every 5 sec while not in combat.
You recover an additional 2.5% of your Health and Mana every 5 sec while not in combat.

136874.name: Conquering Hero
descriptions: Beneficial effects you gain from celebrating the defeat of bosses gain 20% increased duration.
Beneficial effects you gain from celebrating the defeat of bosses gain 40% increased duration.
Beneficial effects you gain from celebrating the defeat of bosses gain 60% increased duration.
Beneficial effects you gain from celebrating the defeat of bosses gain 80% increased duration.
Beneficial effects you gain from celebrating the defeat of bosses gain 100% increased duration.

136875.name: Second Chance
descriptions: Effects gained from celebrating the defeat of bosses will not cancel the first time you die while they are active.

136876.name: Adaptability
descriptions: Reset your spent class talent points.

137382.name: Fel Vitality
descriptions: Increases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.

137383.name: Demonic Sacrifice
descriptions:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 2 hr. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec.

Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

137392.name: Toughness
descriptions: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

137859.name: Improved Stings
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 0 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 0.02 sec.
Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 13%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 0 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 0.03 sec.
Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 0.01 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 0.05 sec.

137860.name: Coup de Grace
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Eviscerate ability against targets afflicted with your Deadly Poison by 1% per application.
Increases the damage of your Eviscerate ability against targets afflicted with your Deadly Poison by 2% per application.

137861.name: Coup de Grace
descriptions: Increases the damage of your Eviscerate ability against targets afflicted with your Deadly Poison by 1% per application.

137879.name: Crusade

racials.name: Will to Survive
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Stun effects.

racials.name: Perception
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

racials.name: Ruthless
racials.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2%.

racials.name: The Human Spirit
racials.description: Spirit increased by 5%.

racials.name: Blood Fury
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

racials.name: Shatter Curse
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 5% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Savage
racials.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1%.

racials.name: Hardiness
racials.description: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

racials.name: Stoneform
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

racials.name: Find Treasure
racials.description: Instant. Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.  Lasts until canceled.

racials.name: Earth Fury
racials.description: Increases your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

racials.name: Big Game Hunter
racials.description: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

racials.name: Elune's Light
racials.description: Instant, 3 min cooldown. Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

racials.name: Shadowmeld
racials.description: Instant, 10 sec cooldown. Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

racials.name: Quickness
racials.description: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

racials.name: Wisp Spirit
racials.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

racials.name: Will of the Forsaken
racials.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

racials.name: Cannibalize
racials.description: 5 yd range, Instant, 2 min cooldown. When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

racials.name: Underwater Breathing
racials.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

racials.name: Touch of the Grave
racials.description: Your spells and attacks with a damage part have a chance (30% for casters, 20% for Paladins, Rogues and Warriors) to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health. 25 sec internal cooldown. Does not break crowd control.

racials.name: War Stomp
racials.description: 0.5 sec cast, 1.5 min cooldown. Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

racials.name: Cultivation
racials.description: Instant. Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

racials.name: Plainsrunning
racials.description: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect. In addition, you move 3% faster while mounted.

racials.name: Endurance
racials.description: Total Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

racials.name: Escape Artist
racials.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

racials.name: Eureka!
racials.description: Instant, 2 min cooldown. For 8 sec, your non-periodic damaging abilities cost 10% less (Mana, Rage or Energy) and deal 10% more damage. For Priests, your non-periodic damaging or healing abilities cost 10% less Mana and do 10% more damage or healing. Periodic effects get nothing from it; a channeled spell is not periodic. The Mage's own tooltip is the one that leaves out non-periodic.

racials.name: Expansive Mind
racials.description: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%, whichever your class uses.

racials.name: Engineering Specialization
